candidate.answerReason: Inverse proportion fixes pS=500×0.2=100. At S=0.5, the pressure is 100/0.5=200 Pa.

methods.label: Find the fixed product
methods.levelReason: Finding the inverse-proportion coefficient and evaluating the formula are standard Grade 9 procedures.

methods.label: Scale the pressure inversely
methods.explanation:
The area increases by a factor of \(0.5/0.2=5/2\). For quantities in inverse proportion, multiplying one quantity by a positive factor divides the other by that factor, keeping their product fixed. Thus the pressure becomes
\[
p=500\div\frac52=500\times\frac25=200\ \text{Pa}.
\]
methods.levelReason: Inverse scaling and fraction arithmetic provide a Grade 6 alternative without determining a function coefficient.
